checklist.name: Bank accounts
checklist.ask: Do you have money in a bank account, a term deposit or an e-wallet?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much, across all of them?

checklist.name: Gold
checklist.ask: Do you own gold — bars, rings or jewellery?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for today?

checklist.name: Investments
checklist.ask: Any investments — shares, fund certificates, an investing app?
checklist.amount: Roughly what are they worth today?

checklist.name: Home
checklist.ask: Do you own the home you live in?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Home loan
checklist.ask: Is there a home loan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?
checklist.hint: Your latest loan statement shows what’s outstanding.

checklist.name: Vehicle
checklist.ask: Do you own a car or a motorbike?
checklist.amount: Roughly what would it sell for?

checklist.name: Vehicle loan
checklist.ask: Is there a loan or an instalment plan on it?
checklist.amount: Roughly how much is left to pay?

checklist.name: Other loans
checklist.ask: Anything else you owe — a consumer loan, a personal loan or a card balance?
